video_title: Jayson Tatum calls Jaylen Brown's departure from the Celtics ‘weird!’ 👀 | First Take

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's recent accomplishments cement his future Hall of Fame status
quotes.excerpt: last night cemented him as a first ballot Hall of Famer
quotes.quote: With all those accomplishments, last night cemented him as a first ballot Hall of Famer. As a future first ballot Hall of Famer, you can't tell me with all the accomplishments that happened just this year that when Jalen Brunson retires, that he's not going to be walking right into the Hall of Fame.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson has achieved the basketball version of the European treble
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson has won the basketball version of the treble this year
quotes.quote: In European soccer, the teams go for what's known as the treble. They want to win their league cup, their national championship, and they want to win the continental championship. Jalen Brunson has won the basketball version of the treble this year.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's contract extension sets a new trend for superstar players
quotes.excerpt: It's a trend already because that's what Jalen Brunson did
quotes.quote: It's a trend already because that's what Jalen Brunson did. Jalen Brunson would not have been able to win that if he didn't have a team built around him. The money that Jalen left was astronomical. It's more than double, potentially. Jalen Brunson's move was even more grandiose. He left it to win all of these honors with a great team around him in New York City.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The NBA Players Union is concerned about superstar players taking less money
quotes.excerpt: The NBA Players Union is not happy about this
quotes.quote: The NBA Players Union is not happy about this. There's a new incoming executive director, David Kelly. He had a press conference in Las Vegas last week and he flagged this as saying this is not good. The idea that a superstar player, now you're creating the expectation that the next superstar player, like Cooper Flagg, is going to be expected to do it.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama needs to develop a post game to reach his potential
quotes.excerpt: Wembanyama has to embrace being a big man first with guard skills
quotes.quote: Wembanyama has to embrace being a big man first with guard skills. He has to get back in the lab with Kareem Abdul-Jabbar and develop a post game. Because at times we saw throughout the course of the NBA Finals, he settled too much, playing away from the basket. You don't have to have weight to be able to have footwork in a post game.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum reflects on the business reality of Jaylen Brown's trade
quotes.excerpt: If I'm being transparent, it's weird
quotes.quote: If I'm being transparent, it's weird. I've been on the Celtics for nine years and he was my teammate every single one of those. You understand throughout the course of a career that the NBA is a business and people change teams and change coaches and front office, but it doesn't make it any easier. There's still a human element of it that you feel those emotions, the city feels those emotions.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins shares his personal experience with being traded from the Celtics
quotes.excerpt: When I was traded from the Celtics in 2010, we shed tears
quotes.quote: When I was traded from the Celtics in 2010, we shed tears. KG, Paul, Rondo, Doc, when we had to have that hard conversation that I was actually traded and moving on. Jayson Tatum said, yeah, it's hard when you've been teammates with a guy. He didn't call him his brother. So again, I'm not sitting up here saying that they had the best relationship or that they had to have the best relationship because they didn't.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Celtics are not rebuilding and expect to remain competitive
quotes.excerpt: The Celtics believe they're going to be in just as good of a footing
quotes.quote: It's more about what Jaylen and Jayson haven't said. Jaylen has had streams and he put out a very long statement that didn't include anything about the Celtics or any individual players. It wasn't just Tatum. He didn't talk about any of his former teammates, including his former head coach and his former executive in Brad Stevens. The Celtics believe they're going to be in just as good of a footing, maybe even better. They're expecting to finish ahead of the 76ers and go farther in the playoffs.
